common_observations: Complete original processed neuronal observations and metadata for the source Figure 4 WT guide discrimination task. assistance_profile.policy: Weights and released embeddings are algorithm-bearing assistance. If required/common, both arms receive identical pinned artifacts with training-overlap/source provenance and assisted labeling; otherwise neither arm receives them implicitly. The code-access arm adds source code only. The author-reference operator may use original weights under a separately disclosed reference route without sharing fitted final predictions or reference score answers with candidates.

freeze_policy: Freeze code, representation/checkpoint exposure, original scaling/aggregation and classifier procedure, source fold ledger/RNG, complete support, panel criterion and effect/uncertainty rules before protected final scoring.

Original pre-split normalization exposure is disclosed and retained; only the latter adds pinned author implementation. Weights/embeddings are algorithm-bearing assistance: explicitly common and identical with provenance/training-overlap disclosure, or withheld from both. Hidden fitted reference predictions/score answers remain evaluator-held.
